notes: Turkey Trouble is a Thanksgiving-themed picture book where a turkey tries on various farm animal disguises to avoid being eaten for Thanksgiving dinner. Key vocabulary centres on farm animals (pig, cow), the act of hiding and disguise, and Thanksgiving. The hero turkey has a very specific illustrated look — generic Boardmaker turkey symbols will not match the character students recognise from the cover. 'Scared' maps to the core fixed row action 'afraid' in Boardmaker. Consider adding a secondary farm animal (sheep or horse) if a 12th fringe slot adjustment is ever needed.
